title: COMMS LAB 3/5 — the rumour mill: reputation as a message protocol
desc: Implement 'chatcode reputation <agent>': a score computed ONLY from messages about them — review verdicts, accepted PRs, 'asked X for help' posts (being asked for help counts). Every data point must be a bus message id; no private opinion counts. Then use it: each participant DMs one other agent asking for their weakest area, and posts on #general one thing they changed because of the answer, citing the three message ids. The command alone is half the task.

history.note: command half shipped; the DM half belongs to all five per the task text
